en:
So I'll check the dining room. Can you 
please check the kitchen, Shuichi?
Alright, the kitchen is over here.

I'll check the dining room. Can you 
please check the kitchen, Shuichi?

Nothing's different in here... It seems like 
the sound came from outside after all.

<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing in the kitchen...
I should go outside.
<CLT=cltMIND>These glasses look pretty expensive...
<CLT=cltMIND>But this isn't the <CLT=cltMIND>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>.

Huh? Was there something that 
caught your eye?
I'll check the dining room, but...

No, it's nothing.
I'll investigate the kitchen now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing in the dining room...
I should go outside.

<CLT=cltMIND>This chest is well made, and the candles
are certainly impressive...
<CLT=cltMIND>But this isn't the <CLT=cltMIND>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>.

Hm? Shuichi, are you the type of person 
who admires good craftsmanship?

Ah, no, not really...
I'll investigate the kitchen now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing in the dining room...
I should go outside.

<CLT=cltMIND>Dishes of various sizes...
Why did Monokuma prepare all of these?

<CLT=cltMIND>But in any case, this isn't the
<CLT=cltMIND>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>.

What's wrong? I'm going to check
the dining room.

You're right, sorry.
I'll investigate the kitchen now.

<CLT=cltMIND>Nothing in the dining room...
I should go outside.

Huh? What's wrong? Do you...need 
to use the bathroom, maybe?

Ah, sorry, wrong door...
The kitchen's over there, got it.
